method: Full source reads of both pinned files; SHA256 recorded and Git blob identities checked against pinned tree. Original data_by_type function extracted with AST and executed on synthetic inputs. Upstream suite not executed.
findings: Cache tests independently compute expected digests for seven algorithms and check exact duplicate/unique/directory path sets. Repeated cache writes, reads and clears exercise hash-unmatched and hash-uniques.

Clamp tests cover false-negative and false-positive cache contamination. Module is skipped without xattr support; namespace test skips when foreign attributes exist. Hardlink regression executes a generated script in its upstream test body; it was not executed here.
Neither reviewed test file exercises a same-size content rewrite with restored mtime, malformed cached digest or NaN timestamp. This is a statement about these two files only.
Replay tests cover basename and hidden filters, tagged originals, cached original preference, sorting, default directory, Unicode names, directory packing/unpacking and hardlinks.

Replay packing/unpacking helper data_by_type explicitly discards is_original and stores False. Therefore its dictionary comparisons cannot validate original selection. Some separate replay tests explicitly assert original flags.

executed_control.scope: Original helper only, synthetic data, no upstream binary execution

limits: No production code changed or performance gain measured.
These source reads do not establish full upstream runtime correctness or all-repository completion.
